name: A Short Game About Nothing
source:
Tired of boring dialogue you don't really care about?

Don't want to be invested in cliche backstory and setting?

Hate being super serious all the time?

You just want to chill?

Look no further, this is a game where you don't do anything.

There also might be a cute girl involved. No promises.

[From [url=https://dont-touch-me.itch.io/a-short-game-about-nothing]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
厌倦了那些你根本不在乎的无聊对话？

不想投入俗套的背景故事与设定？

讨厌总是一本正经？

只是想放松一下？

不用再找了，这是一款什么都不用做的游戏。

也许还会有个可爱的女孩。不保证。

[摘自[url=https://dont-touch-me.itch.io/a-short-game-about-nothing]itch.io[/url]]
